verified_key_information_units.information: Annual headline financial performance for 2025: like-for-like rental income growth of 4.9% (vs 5.6% in 2024), real economic occupancy flat at 98.5%, net operating income margin improved to 72.1% (70.3% in 2024), property values up 2.9% year-on-year, privatization sales of SEK 10,664 million (2,466 units at 28.9% premium), SEK 44,900 million asset-backed financing and SEK 14,600 million capital markets issuance (six green transactions), with credit metrics at Net LTV 52.2% (56.4%) and ICR 2.0x (1.9x).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: 2025 in Brief, Key Figures table, Funding section

candidate_sentences.text: Rental income remained essentially flat at SEK 15,916 million compared with SEK 15,919 million in the previous year, supported by an annualized like-for-like rental growth of 4.9% and stable real economic occupancy of 98.5%.
Consequently, net operating income improved to SEK 11,475 million from SEK 11,188 million, leading to an increased net operating income margin of 72.1% compared to 70.3% in 2024.

The company experienced positive property valuation movements, with fair values of investment properties increasing by 2.9%, generating a fair value gain of SEK 9,498 million compared with SEK 8,553 million previously.

Heimstaden actively pursued its privatisation programme during the year, achieving gross privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million across 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.

Net loan-to-value improved significantly to 52.2% at the end of 2025 compared with 56.4% in 2024, supported by debt repayment funded through cash proceeds from the privatisation programme and asset monetisation.
The interest coverage ratio improved slightly to 2.0x from 1.9x, while interest expenses remained stable at SEK 6,536 million.
The average interest rate at year-end ended at 3.43% compared with 3.01% in the prior year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 performance: like-for-like rental growth of 4.6% (5.3% in Q4 2024), rental income decreased 3.4% to SEK 3,945 million, real economic occupancy rose to 98.7% (98.6% in Q4 2024), net operating income margin held at 70.2% (LTM margin 72.1%), privatization sales of SEK 2,890 million (798 units at 32.5% premium vs 24% in Q4 2024), property values up 0.5%, goodwill impairment loss of SEK 3,707 million, and credit metrics at Net LTV 52.2% (56.4%) and ICR 2.0x (1.9x).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Q4 Highlights, Key Figures table for Q4

verified_key_information_units.information: Operational performance drivers: standing assets contributed SEK 800 million rental income growth via indexation, tenant improvements, and occupancy gains; like-for-like growth decomposed into indexations (3.3% of 4.9% annual growth), tenant improvements (0.7%), occupancy improvements (0.7%), and rent reversion (0.2%); property expenses decreased 6.1% annually to SEK 4,378 million due to digitalisation and portfolio contraction; capital expenditures of SEK 3,893 million allocated to maintenance (SEK 1,790m), sustainability (SEK 557m), tenant improvements (SEK 1,168m), and value-add (SEK 241m).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: MD&A: Rental Income Development, Like-for-like Development, Property Expenses, Asset Management sections
